issues.quote: A junior who reviews usually reads more changes than they write, and sees the other reviewers' comments on each, so meets it sooner than one who only waits to be reviewed.
issues.text: I read this twice to find what 'it' is. Three sentences back the subject was 'the judgement behind them', and in between come 'That shows up only in comments on real changes' and a long sentence about the junior, so 'meets it' does not point anywhere obvious.
issues.fix: Replace 'so meets it sooner' with 'so meets that unwritten judgement sooner'.

issues.quote: on the hosting service the pull request tracks that branch, not a fixed list of commits, so they join it
issues.text: I had to re-read to see that 'they' means the new commits and 'it' the pull request. The idea (push to the same branch and the pull request shows the new commits) is fine once decoded.
issues.fix: Write 'so the new commits appear in the same pull request' instead of 'so they join it'.

issues.quote: Move every check up to the top of the method; that is the way the rest of us lay one out.
issues.text: Try it's expected result asks for a reason that is 'a rule the team holds, not a taste of yours', and option e gives exactly that kind of reason (the team's layout). I hesitated before ruling it out on missing grade and place; the explanation settles it, but only after I answered.
issues.fix: Make e's reason plainly a taste, e.g. 'that is how I would lay it out', so it lines up with the note's 'preference with no reason and no grade' row.
